requirement.original: Fix plan-validate.py NameError: name 'days' is not defined at line 708
requirement.clarified: Insert a missing variable assignment `days = timeline_data.get("data", {}).get("days", [])` before the for-loop at line 708 in the `check_semantics` function of scripts/plan-validate.py.
requirement.what: One-line variable assignment to define `days` in `check_semantics` scope before it is iterated
requirement.why: The loop at line 708 references `days` which was never assigned in this function scope, causing a NameError crash whenever timeline validation runs

included: Add single assignment line before line 708 in check_semantics
excluded: Modifying meal or accommodation validation logic

success_criteria: plan-validate.py runs to completion without NameError when processing timeline agent data
Meal presence and accommodation presence checks execute and produce correct output
constraints: Must use the established pattern: .get("data", {}).get("days", []) — consistent with lines 347, 422, 631, 1030
No other lines may be changed

root_cause_analysis.symptom: NameError: name 'days' is not defined at line 708 when plan-validate.py runs timeline validation
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: check_semantics assigns `timeline_data` at line 689 and passes it to check_travel_segments (which defines its own local `days`), but never assigns `days` in its own scope before the for-loop at line 708
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A — likely introduced when the meal/accommodation loop block was added without copying the standard days-extraction line
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The loop body (lines 708-731) was written assuming `days` would be in scope, but the assignment was omitted
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Python raises NameError at runtime on the first execution of the for-loop; the entire timeline validation section is skipped with a crash

file_contents.scripts/plan-validate.py:700-711: Pre-compute accommodation days (lines 700-706), then for day in days: (line 708) — days undefined

development_approach.strategy: Insert the missing `days` assignment using the established extraction pattern, immediately before the for-loop at line 708

fix_details.new_string:
days = timeline_data.get("data", {}).get("days", [])
        for day in days:

development_approach.validation_approach: Run plan-validate.py against a plan that has timeline data; confirm no NameError and that meal/accommodation checks produce output

research_findings.reason: Straightforward variable scope bug with clear root cause and established fix pattern already present in the same file
